title: feat(security): Runtime identifies callers from verified Supabase tokens (SEC-1c, ADR-0043)

sourceMetadata.subject: feat(security): Runtime identifies callers from verified Supabase tokens (SEC-1c, ADR-0043)
sourceMetadata.body:
Runtime now verifies the Supabase access token itself (ADR-0043 Decisions 1-3, 5) instead of believing role and user headers. A request with a bearer token is identified by that token alone: HS256 with the project JWT secret, or ES256/RS256 against the project's published signing keys (fetched once, refreshed for rotated keys); any other algorithm, alg none included, is refused; the token must be unexpired, issued by this project and for the authenticated audience. The caller is the token's subject with the role from server-written app_metadata; a plan role such as free is a plain user. A present but invalid token is anonymous and never falls back to headers. Team ids are not accepted from verified callers until Runtime keeps team membership. Outside production a development identity can be configured in Runtime's environment (KORELUMINA_DEV_IDENTITY); production refuses it. Built on node:crypto, no new dependency. Verified live in production mode: a valid owner token sees the owner's project; a forged token, a customer token, or headers alone see none. 21 new tests; executive, routes, learning, knowledge and runtime suites 432/432.
